title: feat(test-fixtures): 等待并验证 comment outbox、read-model、cache 与 reply notification edges
body:
Parent: #1725
Depends on: #2177, #2178, #1653, #1716

## 原子目标

消费#2177/#2178 authority receipts，等待并验证CommentMutationOutbox实际驱动public/admin read models、thread/count/cache/invalidation、moderation queue与approved reply notification达到exact terminal state。该issue只负责derived chain观察/验证，不直接写Redis/read model/queue/notification，不实现authority commands、rerun治理或legacy removal。

## 必须交付

1. Required edge set exact来自production comment outbox/event contract与当前variant，不手写第二edge列表或按页面/queue可见性猜完成。
2. 每个edge observation绑定outbox event/version、comment/current revision/status/thread/article/actor fixed coordinates、edge owner/attempt/generation、input/output digest与terminal receipt。
3. Public/admin projections验证thread/root/reply/depth/version/delete placeholder/moderation visibility与privacy fields；pending/rejected/spam不得错误公开。
4. Moderation queue验证exact include/exclude/bucket/reason/order/actor visibility，不以count>0或第一条通过。
5. Thread/count/cache/invalidation验证current revision/status和article relationship，不允许stale generation或手工Redis补偿。
6. Reply notification只在production合同规定的真实approved reply条件下产生，recipient从target comment/actor关系派生；pending/rejected/wrong recipient/duplicate notification失败。
7. Outbox payload必须使用sealed comment/revision/status coordinates；worker读取latest状态导致superseded event污染时失败。
8. Superseded/retry/duplicate delivery遵守production idempotency；同event不得重复read-model row、queue item、cache invalidation或notification。
9. Required edge failure/timeout/cancel/poison/recovery-required使canonical comment unverified，不允许warning、manual rebuild、direct stream/Redis write或mock notification判绿。
10. Edge verifier使用current-run explicit refs，拒绝mtime/latest/first-match/cross-run/stale receipts。
11. Output aggregate记录event/edge terminal vector、public/admin/queue/cache/notification identities/digests、failures/recovery与content digest。
12. Independent verifier重读public/admin APIs、moderation queue、cache/count、notification outbox/stream与edge receipts，检查一致性与tamper。
13. Static governance禁止manual Redis/read-model/queue/notification writes、mock fallback、count/file exists pass与second edge list。

## 固定约束

- 不实现initial/mutation commands。
- 不修复edge workers或修改projection/notification policies。
- 不实现rerun repair/legacy removal。
- 不以HTTP页面/queue count代替edge exactness。
- 不修改#1794。

## 必须测试

- pending public；
- approved missing public/admin；
- queue wrong bucket/order/reason；
- stale thread/count/cache；
- reply notification wrong recipient/status；
- duplicate notification/outbox delivery；
- payload uses latest state；
- edge failure warning；
- manual Redis/read-model/stream/mock；
- poison/recovery-required；
- cross-run/latest receipt；
- privacy exact fields leak；
- aggregate/edge tamper。

## 验收条件

- [ ] Canonical comment只有全部required edges真实terminal success后verified。
- [ ] Public/admin/queue/cache/notification绑定sealed comment coordinates与privacy contract。
- [ ] Failure/stale/duplicate/superseded/poison语义fail closed且可审计。
- [ ] 无manual projection/Redis/notification/mock/count-only验收。
- [ ] 本PR不修改authority commands或legacy paths。

## 非目标

- 不实现comment command/timeline。
- 不修复projection/notification workers。
- 不执行rerun exact repair。
- 不删除legacy helpers/seeds。
